key.name: enabled
key.description: Enable automatic mouse movement to maintain presence

key.name: check-interval
key.description: Seconds between cursor jiggles once the idle threshold has been reached

key.name: idle-seconds
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before moving the mouse cursor

key.name: move-distance
key.description: Number of pixels to move the cursor

key.name: randomize-movement
key.description: Randomize the move distance within 50% to 150% of the set value

key.name: show-notifications
key.description: Show a desktop notification when cursor movement starts (idle) and when you return (active)
